determinations.detail: Representative confirmed the account; interest omitted in error.

Offer deemed processable — levy barred under IRC 6331(k)
Exam opened on TY2024 from the offer investigation referral

effects: TY2024 module re-opens with a $2,417 TC 300 assessment plus statutory interest; a new CSED starts at assessment.
The new TY2024 liability must be brought into the offer, and the Harbor Trust ($28,400) and Meridian ($6,750) balances added to net realizable equity before RCP is recomputed.
Certification stays in place; the debt grows. Acceptance of the offer would still be a reversal trigger under IRC 7345(c).
Enforcement stays suspended — levy remains barred while the offer is pending (IRC 6331(k)).
Understatement $2,417 is below the substantial understatement floor; negligence under IRC 6662(b)(1) considered but not asserted.

meta.title: Individual exam through RVE — real estate professional claim
meta.selection: Classified for field exam: Schedule E claims $64,000 of rental losses as nonpassive under the real estate professional rule on a return with $182,000 of W-2 wages. No Form 8582 was filed.

findings.note: No Form 8582, no aggregation election in MeF or attachments, and no hours data anywhere in MeF. Each rental must be tested separately unless an election exists, so the IDR asks for hours and any election.
Rents for the two managed properties match Schedule E.
Commissions match Schedule C gross receipts.

determinations.detail: 1,450 hours in real estate brokerage, her only work: more than half her personal services and more than 750 hours.

No aggregation election on file, so each rental is a separate activity. Alki 520 hours — material participation. Delridge 90 hours and Burien 60 hours, with the property manager doing more — not material participation. $50,000 of losses are passive.
No passive income. Modified AGI above $150,000, so no $25,000 allowance. $50,000 suspended and carried to 2025 (Delridge $17,000, Burien $33,000).

effects: No assessment yet — the $11,000 deficiency is proposed, unagreed. The TC 150 refund of $837 stands until assessment.

$50,000 of suspended passive losses carry to TY2025 on Form 8582 and are released by passive income or a full disposition (IRC 469(b), (g)). RVE should carry the carryforward into the next year's snapshot.
Protest raises late aggregation-election relief under Rev. Proc. 2011-34. If granted, the three rentals are one activity: 670 hours, material participation, and the adjustment falls away.
ASED 15 Apr 2028. Appeals needs enough statute time remaining when the case arrives; consider Form 872 if the protest stalls.

Understatement $11,000 exceeds the greater of 10% of correct tax or $5,000 — IRC 6662(d) threshold met ($2,200 if asserted). Needs written supervisory approval (IRC 6751(b)); reasonable cause to be weighed.
